findings: high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/ManageArticleRelease.php:420 — Release approval checks unresolved blocking/conflict findings only on the release revision, but still-valid preserved findings after an accepted edit remain anchored to the reviewed base revision and can be ignored once a targeted recheck exists → Include non-stale findings from the reviewed base batch tied to the targeted recheck, or explicitly carry forward/stale them, before allowing release approval

high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/ManageArticleRelease.php:466 — Targeted recheck readiness treats any completed recheck for the target revision as sufficient and does not inspect unresolved recheck output or require new blocking findings to be resolved → Require completed rechecks to have no unresolved affected areas and ensure new blocking findings are persisted and resolved before release approval
